notes: אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ is read under rule 43: the clause is verbless, so the possessive לְ carries the *hath* and its suffix takes the subject pronoun *he*.
שַׂכְתָּ → *made a hedge* is a light verb plus complement and heads on *hedge* (rule 44), with the indefinite *a* on that nominal (rule 15).
Variant WLC.JOB.1.10.v002 is underdetermined and its base reading (the explicit pronoun s003) is compatible with the ASV's *thou*; no textual decision is made here (rule 9).
